quantifiers.label: Delay Detection Accuracy
quantifiers.summary: Percentage of shipments correctly classified as delayed or on-time.
quantifiers.derivation: Measured on a stratified 20% holdout dataset using HistGradientBoostingClassifier. The model correctly classified 73.0% of shipments.

quantifiers.label: High-Risk Shipment Detection
quantifiers.summary: Percentage of delayed shipments successfully identified before execution.
quantifiers.derivation: Measured as recall on delayed shipments. The model identified 68.0% of logistics events that eventually experienced delays.

quantifiers.label: Cross-Validated Reliability
quantifiers.summary: Average predictive reliability across five independent validation folds.
quantifiers.derivation: Calculated using 5-fold cross-validation with ROC-AUC scoring. Mean ROC-AUC achieved 78.3%.
